page.overview:
Who is Baseball Bat?

Baseball Bat is a member of the in Tales of the TMNT. He takes his orders from and .

After escapes from Mechazoid 02, he climbs up out of the river and coughs up a small turtle. He then hears a young woman ask if the turtle just coughed up another turtle and when Raph looks up, he sees a pair of young humans staring at him. The young man, Boomerang Dragon, turns to his fellow who are in a nearby delivery truck and says that the big turtle coughed up a little turtle. As Pipe Dragon hands a box to Baseball Bat inside the truck, Hammer Dragon, seated atop the truck, asks if that makes him a cannibal. Raph stands up and starts to threaten them, but then passes out. The young woman, , and Boomerang Dragon drag Raph over to their truck.

Raph finds himself held captive by the Purple Dragons inside the Gently Plucked Chicken Company factory. Baseball Bat is among the group who stands at attention as their boss, examines Raph. After she leaves, Raph begins stalling the Dragons by telling jokes as he waits for Mechazoid 02 to arrive. His third chicken joke makes Baseball Bat start laughing. After the Mechazoid breaks into the factory, orders the Dragons to get it and Baseball Bat is the first to attack, striking the Mechazoid in the head with his Baseball bat and causing it to stumble backwards. Mechazoid 02 recovers quickly and on Baseball Bat's next attempt to hit it, the robot knocks him down. While Hun is beating on the robot with Bricky, the other Dragons recover and go to surround the Mechazoid. It flings Hun away, and then kicks Baseball Bat clear across the factory floor. When the Mechazoid has Hun down and is attempting to stab him, the other Dragons run.
